title: 2-colouring shift-chains
summary: A shift-chain is an $ r $-uniform hypergraph $ \mathcal{H} $ on vertex set $ [n] $ with the property that, for any two edges $ \{ e_1, \ldots, e_r \} $ and $ \{ f_1, \ldots, f_r \} $ with $ e_1 < \cdots < e_r $ and $ f_1 < \cdots < f_r $, either $ e_i \le f_i $ for all $ i \in [r] $ or $ f_i \le e_i $ for all $ i \in [r] $. It is known that all shift-chains are properly vertex-colourable with three colours (that is, such that no edge is monochromatic), which is optimal for $ r \in \{ 2, 3 \} $.
